deploy-bot: Deploy initiated — canary start for release rwinf/v2.4.7-release-2026-03-19
deploy-bot: env=prod region=us-west-2 target=canary-pool rollout_initial=5%
deploy-bot: commit=rwinf/v2.4.7 tag=v2.4.7-canary author=@Jen
Jen Park: ACK. pinning predictor-service to v2.4.7-quant for canary to reduce perf regressions we saw in staging.
Mike R.: Watching key signals: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token throughput. Will post quick snapshots.
Mike R.: Snapshot -> p95 +8ms vs baseline, 5xx steady, cpu on canary nodes ~72% (expected under 80%).
Kai L.: Ran a quick safety eval on the curated prompt subset — hallucination rate moved 0.5% -> 0.9% on that slice. Small but notable.
Jen Park: Hold promotion. We should run an A/B comparing quant vs fp32 on that prompt set before more traffic.
sre-oncall: I'll tail the canary logs and watch for OOM/queue spikes.
Mike R.: Applied a small rollout config patch to add an extra pause step. Snippet below:
```
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  steps:
    - setWeight: 5
    - pause: 10m
    - setWeight: 20
```
Jen Park: OK. After A/B completes and safety verifies, I'll approve a bump to 20%.
deploy-bot: Manual approval requested by @Jen Park — to promote to 20% run `/deploy approve 1850123456`.
Jen Park: /deploy approve 1850123456 :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Promotion executed — canary now at 20% (tag=v2.4.7). Rollback window=30m.
Mike R.: Monitoring dashboard -> https://dash.internal/rw/canary/1850123456 (internal)
sre-oncall: No anomalies so far, latencies within acceptable band, no 5xx spike.
Kai L.: A/B completed: quant variant slightly worse on that prompt; fp32 performed better there. Suggest pinning that specific route to fp32.
Jen Park: Understood. I'll pin route `/v1/generate` for traffic to v2.4.7-fp32 for now and keep the rest on quant.
Jen Park: Quick note for release notes: mention model pin for safety prompt set + canary rollout details.
deploy-bot: Canaries have been stable for 30m. Scheduled full promotion to 100% at 2026-03-19T12:50:00Z unless a rollback is requested.
sre-oncall: 👍 standing by to initiate rollback if any regressions appear.
Jen Park: Thanks all — I'll open follow-up PR with pinned routes, the A/B results, and the release notes summary.
